title: Visa beefs up cybersecurity offerings with $2.4 billion BioCatch deal
description: Visa agreed to acquire BioCatch for $2.4 billion in cash, adding BioCatch's behavioral biometrics and fraud-detection technology to Visa's cyber and risk products.

title: Visa to buy Israeli cyber firm for $2.4 billion to fight AI-driven scams
description: The report covers Visa's planned $2.4 billion purchase of BioCatch and describes BioCatch's behavioral biometrics platform for detecting financial fraud and account takeovers.

title: Visa buys Israeli fraud prevention co BioCatch for $2.4b
description: Globes reports that Visa signed an agreement to acquire BioCatch for $2.4 billion, highlighting BioCatch's fraud-prevention technology, customer base and recent growth.

title: Visa acquires behavioral biometrics pioneer BioCatch amid fraud prevention build-up
description: Biometric Update reports on Visa's $2.4 billion acquisition of BioCatch and describes the company as a behavioral biometrics and fraud-detection specialist serving banks worldwide.

title: Visa buys Israel's BioCatch for $2.4b
description: The Jerusalem Post reports that Visa is acquiring BioCatch for $2.4 billion and notes BioCatch's use of AI and behavioral signals to help financial institutions prevent fraud.
